content.text: I have enough to answer. Two faults reach the user-facing frontend, one in `profile` and one in `frontend`'s `/recommendations` handling.

input.reflection: Findings: (1) profile: zero spans in abnormal, k8s.deployment.available = 0 for all 18 abnormal samples (1 in normal), desired=1. Profile pod is gone for the whole window -> pod_unavailable. Frontend's profile.Profile/GetProfiles client spans fail in ~0.01ms (Error, 856), frontend logs 'Get profiles failed' (607 ERROR), and frontend HTTP /hotels returns 500 (518 Error vs 0 normal). (2) frontend HTTP /recommendations returns 500 on all 338 requests, but its client calls to recommendation are Unset and recommendation's own server spans are Unset with no error logs; latency is lower (0.55ms vs 1.15ms). Error is produced at frontend's HTTP layer with the backend response intact -> http_wrong_status_code at frontend. Propagation: profile -> frontend; frontend is the user-facing tier. Search/reservation/rate/geo volume shifts are traffic changes, not errors.
